tagline: Sell your harvest at a fair price — no middlemen.

landing.heroBody: FarmLink AI connects verified Indian farmers directly to verified wholesale buyers. Real mandi prices, AI-calculated fair rates, zero commissions, and complete price transparency.
landing.step1b: Form, voice call or SMS — large buttons, simple words.
landing.step2b: Prophet forecast and safe range. Choose your price within the recommended band.
landing.step3b: Nearby verified buyers. Large quantities are automatically split.
landing.step4b: Pickup route is shown. Money stays in escrow until delivery, then goes to your bank.
landing.calcHint: Mandi traders may retain 30–40%. FarmLink keeps more value with the farmer.
landing.noSmartphoneTitle: No Smartphone? Call or SMS Our AI Service
landing.noSmartphoneBody: Farmers without internet can dial or text our dedicated toll-free helpline. Speak naturally or send simple messages in Hindi, Marathi, or English to list crops and receive instant market rates.
landing.aiExtracts: AI extracts crop, quantity, and location automatically.
landing.verificationBody: No anonymous buyers, no fictitious listings. Every user completes multi-step verification before direct contact details are shared.
landing.identityCheckBody: Every farmer and buyer verifies their mobile via 6-digit OTP and completes sandbox KYC check.
landing.businessProofBody: Farmers confirm land/FPO registration. Buyers submit valid GSTIN, Udyam, or municipal trade licence.
landing.directTradeBody: Only verified buyers see direct farmer phone numbers, ensuring privacy, zero middlemen, and reliable payments.
landing.demoNote: Demo accounts are ready — no signup required to explore.
